about: What a single-node k3s server costs, idle and with Odoo instances of the Sudoo.sh Kubernetes engine (beta). A local measurement, not a guarantee: see docs/KUBERNETES_ENGINE.md, section 14. Made with perf/k3s_measure.py.
machine: Development machine: Intel Core i7-11800H (16 threads), 15 GB of memory, Docker 29.1; k3s in one privileged Docker container (k3s in Docker), not a VPS.
method: Local measurement only: one k3s server node in a Docker container on a development machine (k3s v1.36.6+k3s1, Traefik and servicelb off, metrics-server, CoreDNS and local-path on), measured with docker stats every 5 s for 120 s after 120 s of rest. Instances: Odoo 18.0 Community with only the base module and PostgreSQL 16, idle (no visitors), made by the Kubernetes engine (one namespace each). Figures are the whole node: k3s, containerd and every pod.

recommendation.note: At least 8 GB for the panel, k3s and a few instances with real data and visitors; 4 GB is enough to try one or two instances.
